name: Grim Borough
storyline:
The Timestrikers have cropped up yet again in Medieval Scandinavia, this time in a small platoon warping the natives into horrific mutants and even raising the buried dead.
You, Corporal Alexei, have been chosen to eliminate this alien threat by any means possible. Grab your rifle, slip into your combat armour and finish off the last remaining Timestrikers.
summary:
Grim Borough; a short but sweet map pack designed by Jerry with help from Re-fund (AKA racx_00) for Chasm: The Rift. See the description for further info.

In this short set of three levels you play as Corporal Alexei, who has received a seek-and-destroy mission from HQ to wipe out one of the last Timestriker platoons in existence. Keep an eye out for all 5 secret supply drops!
